text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Phee～w! Shrines are just great. I feel 
cleansed of all kinds of things!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I've been lacking in Bakushin lately. Or 
rather, I should say I thought I'd been 
feeling out of sorts, but…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I feel like I can solve 
aaaany problem, without hesitation!
――Uwaa～h! What am I supposed to do～～!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Excellent timing, troubled voice! 
Let's have the class president handle 
this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oya! It's Ms. Biko! What seems to be the 
problem!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-Senpai! I don't know what I'm 
supposed to doo―!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heroes have to constantly come up with new 
special moves to fight evil, but…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I can't think of anything! I've asked God 
for help, and I've gotten none!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! Then, this class president and 
honor student! Leave it to this brainiac!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Decidedly! All you need, is Bakushin!
choice_data_list: What happened to that brain of yours!?
What happened to that brain of yours!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Therefore, if you Bakushin, you can… 
if you, then, ehh～～……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes! I meant, all different sorts of 
things stimulate the brain!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Come, now! Straight at the sun～… Bakushinbakushiiiiiiii――――n!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! It's like a training session, a 
passionate one! Bakushinbakushiii―n!!

They took off towards the sun, and I 
hurriedly chased after them…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hah… hah……!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the sunset when you're able to 
Bakushin with all your might is… 
spectacularly special, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! Bakushin's super awesome! I feel so 
refreshed, and now I can do my special 
move――

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ha! That's right! Make that run you just 
did into an entrance pose…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Haaa-ha-ha-haa―! What do you think! This 
is the class president's plan! It's the 
power of Bakushin!

Sakura Bakushin O smiles with 
satisfaction, and it looks like her 
condition has improved nicely!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Haah… haaah……
choice_data_list:
Looks like your condition's not great 
after all…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: N, no! This is no reason to stop my legs!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
… No, right here is just fine! I can 
totally feel your enthusiasm, Bakushin 
O-Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up, just keep trying! I'm going 
to use my special move, my guts, to 
inspire you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh… I regret that I cannot help you……

Even though she paid her respects at the 
shrine, Sakura Bakushin O wasn't back in 
shape…
